source_conflicts: Alternate HTML 'National Housing Development Authority.html' (srilankalaw.lk) is the Act as enacted: 84 sections, 'BE it enacted ...', s.1 refers to an 'appointed date', no chain, no 69A-69G or 73A. Not a conflict in the consolidated text; recorded because the two copies are different editions.
statute_note: Principal source selected: the LankaLaw consolidated HTML (data/legal-sources/library/statutes/HTML/17-1979-national-housing-development-authority-act.html, identifier 1981Y12V337C-1), parsed by the earlier worker into the accepted tree, 92 sections in 9 Parts (ss.1-84 plus 69A-69G and 73A). Other sources inspected: the srilankalaw.lk as-enacted HTML (statutes/HTML/National Housing Development Authority.html, 84 sections; in the package as a verification source); the LankaLaw HTML and Government Printer copies of the five amending Acts (5 of 1982 and 20 of 1988 as scans read as images, 30 of 1999, 23 of 2002 and 32 of 2003 with text layers checked by check_parse_coverage); the Monetary Law (Amendment) Act, No. 32 of 2002 in PDF and HTML, read and excluded. No PDF of the principal Act is held (registry status indexed-html). Consolidation cutoff: Act No. 32 of 2003, from the chain header. Review performed: packaging pass. The accepted tree is byte-identical in content to data/processed/canonical-statutes/SRC075-17-1979.json before this pass. validate_finalized_trees: 0 errors; five warnings, all now documented in quality_flags: s.67's references are external (Civil Procedure Code ss.755-756); s.10 is 'Repealed.' with no heading as printed; s.69G prints no marginal note in either the HTML or the GP PDF of Act 30 of 1999; ss.5, 36, 37, 49, 57 and 73A repeat their paragraphs in the section text (parser artefact, nothing lost). The earlier 5-lens review (1 round) is recorded in canonical-overrides.json SRC075. Amendment coverage: all five chain instruments held in two copies each and parsed from HTML; their instructions agree with the baseline's markers and text; nothing applied, nothing applied twice. 32 of 2002 is the Monetary Law (Amendment) Act and is excluded. OCR or structural weaknesses: the source carries transcription damage in ss.4 and 7 ('shall Up-'), kept as printed; the lowercase 'section 69c' in s.69D(1)(iv) is as printed. Missing sources: the body of the First Schedule (renamed by Act 30 of 1999 s.4, amended by Act 23 of 2002 s.4) is printed by no held source; the Second Schedule inserted by Act 30 of 1999 s.5 is printed only by that Act's Government Printer PDF (pp.11-12) and has not been transcribed, and the HTML of Act 30 of 1999 ends at the word 'Schedules'. Unresolved questions: the two Schedule bodies; whether the curriculum's '32 of 2002' meant 32 of 2003.
